name: ReadableAppName
description: Portable OMI-owned enriched blueprint for turning a visual source or reviewed shell-first scaffold into structured UI guidance before prompt emission.

target_context.target_mode: existing-app | verified blank shell | shell-first scaffold
target_context.readable_app_name: Readable app name for the verified or explicitly approved target
target_context.canonical_app_key: Canonical app key once verified or returned by an approved create flow
existing_assets: Verified screen names, blocks, entities, roles, or theme assets already present in the target app
review_notes: Record boundary decisions, deferred chrome work, and review-only assumptions here

evidence_boundary.evidence_status: Current official | Catalog-backed official | OutSystems-public implementation evidence | Unverified gap
grounding_notes: Name the current docs, generated catalogs, implementation references, or tenant observations that ground the artifact
review_notes: Keep unresolved visual-source assumptions, shell-state unknowns, and follow-up checks here

app_chrome._comment: Shared layout chrome defined once and reused across authenticated screens. Shell-first scaffold work may defer chrome only when the review notes say so explicitly.

logo.text: App logo text or image reference
logo.style: compact brand mark with restrained border radius and theme-aligned background

sidebar.app_title: Readable app title shown in chrome
sidebar.active_style: Muted surface tint, left-edge emphasis, and strong label contrast for the active item
sidebar.inactive_style: Low-noise label treatment with hover feedback and no decorative gradients

content.style: Search input with icon, compact radius, and quiet background tint
content.action: Filters or routes to the primary searchable view

content.style: Avatar plus short identity text aligned to the right

blocks._comment: Reusable Web Blocks defined once in Common UIFlow and referenced by name from sections instead of re-describing the same pattern inline.
blocks.name: MetricCard
blocks.description: Compact KPI card with title, value, delta, and optional supporting note

inputs.name: Title
inputs.description: Short label for the KPI being displayed

inputs.name: Value
inputs.description: Primary KPI value already formatted for display

inputs.name: TrendIsPositive
inputs.description: Controls positive or warning visual treatment

blocks.layout: Vertical stack with compact title row, large value row, and secondary note aligned under the value
blocks.usage_example: Overview screen uses MetricCard in the top KPI group; list detail summaries reuse the same block with different footer actions

design_system._comment: Complete visual design system carried into OMI so prompt packets and scaffold work stay anchored to explicit tokens instead of ad hoc styling.

gradients.usage: Restrained emphasis for summary banners only

visual_rules: Prefer OutSystems UI utilities before custom classes.
Keep chrome restrained and operational rather than decorative.
Preserve contrast and explicit hover or active feedback for commands.
Use tokenized colors and spacing instead of screen-local styling drift.

theme_extensions._comment: Single source of truth for custom CSS variables and classes that are not covered by standard OutSystems UI utilities.

classes._comment: Each class should stay thin and rely on variables above.
classes.name: metric-card
classes.rule: background: var(--surface-bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); box-shadow: var(--card-shadow); border-radius: 12px;

entities._comment: Create-only data model for the reviewed scope. Keep separately verified reusable tenant assets in target_context.existing_assets; do not duplicate them in entities.
entities.name: WorkItem

screens._comment_authenticated: Authenticated screen that uses shared app_chrome. Title and subtitle describe the screen-level frame; main_content describes only the body sections.
screens.name: Overview
screens.description: Operational overview of work items, status distribution, and next actions.
screens.title: Overview
screens.subtitle: Current workload, recent movement, and action points.

main_content.name: KPI Summary
main_content.description: Top-level KPI cards showing active work, blocked work, and completed work.

data_source.filter: Show current items relevant to the signed-in user's workspace
data_source.sort: Newest activity first for secondary lists; KPI counts aggregate across the filtered set

content.data: Aggregate counts for active, blocked, and completed work items
content.label: Summary KPIs
content.typography: page-title for values, body for labels and notes
content.action: Cards are display-first; optional footer actions route to filtered list views

main_content.conditional_rendering: Trend markers and status color treatment change according to the aggregate result set.

main_content._comment: Group section for list and sidebar detail.
main_content.name: Work Queue And Notes

items.name: Priority queue
items.description: Most urgent work items with status badge, owner, and due date

content.data: Title, owner, due date, and status badge

items.name: Review notes
content: Display the shell-state notes, open issues, or deferred chrome decisions from review_notes.

popups.name: FilterSummaryPopup
popups.trigger: Filter summary button in the header

content.data: Selected filters, sort order, and data freshness note

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Full access to configuration and operational workflows.

roles.name: Contributor
roles.description: Can update records and act on assigned work.

roles.name: Viewer
roles.description: Read-only access to dashboards and record details.

acceptance_checklist: target_context captures the verified or explicitly approved target before prompt emission.
evidence_boundary records the grounded evidence status plus review-only gaps.
app_chrome is defined once and reused consistently across authenticated screens.
Reusable blocks are named, parameterized, and referenced instead of copied inline.
design_system tokens drive colors, spacing, radius, shadows, and custom classes.
entities stay aligned with the reviewed scope and reuse verified shell assets where possible.
screens preserve producer-first data flow, section ordering, and explicit permissions.
Visual-Source UI Prompt Packet is emitted from this enriched blueprint rather than replacing it.

No sessionId, mentor_session_id, mentor_session_token, env_key, implicit mentor_prompt or mentor_create_asset (pre-2026-09: mentor_start), implicit publish via mentor_publish (pre-2026-09: publish_start), or Claude-only cache paths are added to the asset.
